intro.h2: Remodeling that moves as fast as you do
paragraphs: GMG Home Solutions handles bathroom remodeling in Raleigh-Durham, NC, along with countertops and backsplashes. What sets us apart is speed without shortcuts. One client heard back within an hour, had an estimate visit the next morning, a quote an hour later and the install the following day.

Another homeowner went from first phone call to finished countertop replacement in about a week. Our bigger jobs get the same care. A longtime client came back years after his granite install to renovate his master bath, kept his Brazilian granite for a new vanity and says the cost was very reasonable for the craftsmanship and advice.

items.name: Master bathroom renovations
items.blurb: Full bathroom renovations with new tile, plumbing fixtures, vanities and glass. Guillermo guides you through tile and fixture choices. One recent master bath got deep green herringbone tile, a pebble shower floor, lighted mirrors and the owner's original Brazilian granite on a new vanity.

image.alt: Master bathroom with green herringbone wall tile, dark wood vanity with granite top and lighted mirrors

items.name: Tile showers
items.blurb: Walk-in showers with frameless glass, recessed niches and pebble or marble-look floors. We set herringbone, large-format and mosaic tile with clean lines, so the shower becomes the centerpiece of the bathroom instead of the part you want to hide.

image.alt: Walk-in shower with green herringbone tile, two lit niches, pebble floor and frameless glass door

items.name: Granite and quartz countertops
items.blurb: We install custom granite and quartz countertops in kitchens and bathrooms. One countertop replacement went from a same-day site visit and quote to prep the next day, and the full job was done in roughly a week from the first conversation.

image.alt: L-shaped white quartz kitchen countertop with built-in cooktop and undermount sink

items.name: Kitchen backsplash
items.blurb: A new backsplash can change a kitchen in a day. Luis and two crew members handle the prep, cutting and cleanup. One client booked us through Thumbtack, got a very reasonable quote within an hour of the visit and had it installed the next day.

image.alt: Kitchen with white marble herringbone backsplash, wood cabinets and white quartz island

items.title: Quick answers, quick starts
items.text: Reviewers describe replies within an hour, estimate visits the same or next day, and installs as soon as the following day. One says she had never seen such a timely response.

items.title: Family-run team
items.text: Owner Guillermo works alongside his son Guillermo and installer Luis. You talk to the people doing the job, from the first call to the cleanup.

items.title: Clients come back
items.text: One homeowner had us install Brazilian granite in his kitchen and master bath years ago, then returned to have us renovate the whole master bath.

items.title: Reasonable, on schedule
items.text: Clients call our pricing very reasonable for the craftsmanship and advice, say the work finished on schedule, and note that any issues were addressed immediately.

about.text: GMG Home Solutions LLC is a bathroom remodeler led by owner Guillermo. He works with his son, also named Guillermo, who often sends quotes, and with installer Luis and his crew. Some clients first hired GMG for custom granite countertops and came back years later for a full bathroom renovation. Today the team takes on bathrooms, countertop replacements and backsplashes. Clients mention the same things again and again: fast replies, sound advice on tile and fixtures, careful prep and cleanup, and a work ethic that makes them want to hire us again. Contact us for a free quote.

items.name: Kenneth G.
items.text: I first worked with Guillermo ,owner of GMG Home Solutions LLC, years ago when they installed beautiful Brazilian granite custom counter tops in my kitchen and master bath. I was happy enough to reach out again when I wanted to totally renovate my master bath, but wanted to still use the same granite on a different sized Vanity. Guillermo helped guide us through excellent choices of gorgeous tile and beautiful plumbing fixtures. All of the work was done very efficiently with great detail and care. The cost considering all the services, craftsmanship and sound advice was very reasonable and done on schedule. Any issues were immediately addressed and I couldn’t be happier. I highly recommend this company to help with your remodeling projects.

items.name: Irene M.
items.text: Had GMG Home Solutions install a kitchen backsplash for me.They were absolutely wonderful to work with. I went on thumbtack and the owner Guillermo responded within an hour and we set up an appointment to come by the next morning for an estimate. Within an hour of his visit I had a response from his son Guillermo with a very reasonable quote and that they could install the next day. Luis the installer,  and his two other crew members, assisted with prepping, cutting, and cleanup. What an efficient group! I will use them again in a heartbeat. In recent years I have never a such a timely response and such great work ethic and workmanship. Give them a call you won’t be sorry!

items.name: John D.
items.text: Guillermo and his team were fantastic to work with from start to finish. He was extremely prompt to talk out the overall job scope. Came out on site same day to gather info and quote and was back the next day to prep for the counter replacement. Full job was completed in roughly 1 week from initial conversation. Highly recommend for your countertop upgrade needs and any other projects they can take on.

service_area.text: GMG Home Solutions is a service-area business, so we come to you for bathroom renovations, countertops and backsplashes. Our phone number is a Raleigh-Durham area line, (919) 813-9223. Call Monday to Friday from 9 AM to 6 PM or Saturday from 9 AM to 3 PM, tell us your town, and we will let you know right away if we can schedule a visit.

items.a: Often very quickly. One client had an estimate visit the morning after she reached out and her backsplash installed the day after the quote. Another had a same-day site visit, prep the next day and the countertop job done in about a week.

Yes. We offer free quotes. Call (919) 813-9223 or email info@gmghomesolutionsllc.com, and we will set up a time to see the space. Clients describe our quotes as very reasonable and say they often arrive within an hour of the visit.

items.q: Can I reuse my existing granite in a new bathroom?
items.a: In some cases, yes. A longtime client wanted to keep his Brazilian granite while renovating his master bath with a different-sized vanity. Guillermo worked it into the new design along with new tile and plumbing fixtures. Ask us about your stone during the visit.

We are open Monday through Friday from 9 AM to 6 PM and Saturday from 9 AM to 3 PM. We are closed on Sunday. You can also email info@gmghomesolutionsllc.com at any time or reach us through Thumbtack, and we will get back to you during business hours.

items.q: Who will be working in my home?
items.a: Owner Guillermo, his son Guillermo, and installer Luis with his crew. Clients describe them as efficient and careful, with a great work ethic, and say the crew handled the prepping, cutting and cleanup on their projects, and left the house clean when the work was done.

final_cta.text: Call Guillermo and his team for a free quote on your project.
